propositions: Project-supplied code-review criteria's applies_to field is stored but never validated at load, never read at dispatch, and never matched against changed files, causing criteria to run on every review regardless of file changes.

The applies_to field exists in effective_routing() and is retrievable but remains unread by all dispatch code paths — _activated_code_review_project_criteria filters only on criterion_id prefix and exec type, taking no changed-files argument.
Plan-review project criteria ARE gated on applies_at and file impacts with validation at load, but code-review has no counterpart — creating an asymmetry that reveals the code-review defect.

applies_to lacks shape validation at overlay load, allowing malformed values (bare strings, non-lists, non-string elements) to be stored silently and revert to empty list behavior instead of failing loudly.

The dispatch must gate project code-review criteria against changed files using the same glob-matching and changed-files list as the triggers step, with an empty applies_to remaining always-on by design.
